subject: One-off invoice consolidation & staged-remit approval request — Lindenbrook pilot
messages:
From: Asha Raman <asha.raman@lindenbrook.k12.us>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Vale <marcus.vale@lindenbrook.k12.us>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request — consolidated invoice + staged remits for pilot district

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. Lindenbrook is excited to run the spring pilot across five schools, but procurement has strict monthly budget lines and can only sign a single quarterly purchase order for contracted services. They have requested two things before execution:

- A single consolidated invoice at project start for the quarter (so their AP can match to the PO)
- Allow staged remittances tied to three delivery milestones (30%, 40%, 30%) over the quarter

We understand Lindenbrook’s constraints but this deviates from Redwood’s standard monthly billing cadence. Can you advise what executive approval we need for a one-off invoice consolidation and a three-tranche remit schedule for this K-12 pilot?

I attached the LUSD procurement form and a suggested payment_plan_summary.xlsx that maps milestones to deliverables.

Appreciate quick guidance — they want to finalize by Friday.

Best,
Asha Raman
Director of EdTech Procurement
Lindenbrook Unified School District
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Asha Raman <asha.raman@lindenbrook.k12.us>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-02T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — consolidated invoice + staged remits for pilot district

Asha — thanks for the detail and the files.

Quick summary for internal routing: LUSD needs a single invoice at contract signature (quarterly consolidated), but will pay Redwood in three milestone remittances. That means we’d need an exception from our standard monthly invoice cadence and a written exec approval for an invoice + staged remit structure.

Jonas / Monica — looping you in to confirm impacts on cashflow and legal. Is there an acceptable control we can require (e.g., escrow holdback on final tranche or invoice credit schedule) to mitigate risk?

I’ve attached the draft SOW (SOW-Lindenbrook-v2.docx) and our suggested mutual action plan. Asha — can you confirm the exact PO wording procurement will put on the consolidated invoice? That will help Legal match terms.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — consolidated invoice + staged remits for pilot district

Karthik — reviewed the attachments. Operational notes:

- Cashflow: Consolidated invoice at T0 + staged remits means we recognize revenue per ASC/contract schedule, but we should ensure AR tracking accounts for the tranches.
- Risk controls: Recommend two items for approval: 1) escrow-style retention on final 30% until completion sign-off, or 2) a short-term performance credit (2% holdback) that converts to invoice credit if milestone not met.
- Accounting: We can accept single consolidated invoice if Finance receives an itemized schedule (payment_plan_summary.xlsx is fine).

If Legal signs off on SOW terms (liability and termination language referencing staged payments), I’m comfortable escalating for exec approval.

Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request — consolidated invoice + staged remits for pilot district

All — I reviewed contract side. Two asks before we bring this to execs:

1) Add a clause that final tranche is contingent on LUSD acceptance testing sign-off (defined acceptance checklist in SOW).
2) Add a short late-payment interest in case a tranche misses the scheduled remit (net terms remain as described on PO).

With those controls, Legal is OK to support the exception. Recommend we propose the following to Lindenbrook in the approval memo: consolidated invoice at signature, payment schedule 30/40/30, 10-day acceptance window post-milestone, 1.5% monthly late interest after 15 days.

If you want, I can draft a one-page approval memo for exec review with proposed mitigations.

-Monica
Lead Counsel, Contracts
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: BoardApproval@redwood.ai, finance-approvals@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, Asha Raman <asha.raman@lindenbrook.k12.us>, Marcus Vale <marcus.vale@lindenbrook.k12.us>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Exec approval request — one-off consolidated invoice + staged remits for Lindenbrook pilot (DL-2027-0913)

Team — requesting one-off executive approval for a billing exception on the Lindenbrook pilot. Key facts:

- Account: Lindenbrook Unified School District (K-12 pilot across 5 schools)
- Ask: Allow a single consolidated invoice at contract signature (quarterly invoice) with payment remittances in three tranches (30% / 40% / 30%) tied to delivery milestones over the quarter.
- Rationale: Lindenbrook procurement requires a single invoice per PO cycle; approving this removes a material procurement blocker and secures footprint in a large district.
- Controls proposed (recommended by Revenue Ops / Legal):
  * Itemized payment schedule attached (payment_plan_summary.xlsx)
  * Final 30% contingent on acceptance sign-off (per SOW acceptance checklist)
  * 1.5% monthly late interest after 15 days for missed tranche payments
  * Finance to hold final tranche in a restricted receivable (cashbook flag) until sign-off

Attachments: LUSD_MutualActionPlan.pdf; SOW-Lindenbrook-v2.docx; payment_plan_summary.xlsx

Request: approval to proceed with one-off billing exception for this pilot. Please reply all with APPROVE or DECLINE + any conditions. Time-sensitive — Lindenbrook needs confirmation by COB Friday.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
